briefdescription.para: Class representing a fixed offset frame, which is defined by a fixed spatial and/or angular offset from a parent frame.

detaileddescription.para: This class allows for the definition of frames that are not aligned with their parent frame, such as a spacecraft body frame that is offset from an inertial frame.

parameterdescription.para: The parent frame from which this frame is derived. Must satisfy the IsFrame concept.

A variadic list of template parameters that define the spatial and/or angular offsets. These can be distances for spatial offsets or angles for angular offsets, along with an optional rotation sequence for the angular offsets.
